origin.note: TV 原创；无漫画 File 对应。

culprit.zhHans: 外科医生白井光雄（Mitsuo Shirai）

motive.zhHans: 被害人江藤胜敏长期嘲讽他，还以揭发手段逼他退出两人争抢的晋升名额，他遂起杀意。

method.zhHans: 先用 CPR 假人做前三夜的「幻影刺杀」：借对面房间的灯光把人影投到小五郎房的窗上，让人以为小五郎出现幻觉、精神失常，便于把罪栽给他；第四夜在对面房间真实刺杀江藤，再以钝器打昏小五郎并把刀塞进他手里。

evidence.zhHans: 咖啡杯上没有他的指纹：他戴乳胶手套捏住杯把冲洗，护士的指纹却仍留在杯上；他称自己清洗过杯子，无法解释为何只洗掉自己的指纹。另查到他根本不在办公室，是用免提电话与护士通话制造在场假象。

resolution.zhHans: 白井当面对质后认罪，交代动机与被打压的晋升竞争；小五郎洗清嫌疑。

summary.en: Kogoro is in the hospital after his leg injured by a criminal he was chasing down. While there, he witnesses a silhouette of one person stabbing another person in the back. He notifies the nurses immediately, only to find out that the room in which the murder took place is empty. This happens continuously for three nights in a row, before an actual murder has taken place on the 4th night. Even worse, Kogoro is found passed out next to the corpse and mistaken to be the killer, and now Conan will have to clear his name.

suspects: Katsutoshi Eto, Mitsuo Shirai, Keiko Okita and Kazumi Nakayama
Mitsuo Shirai, Keiko Okita and Kazumi Nakayama
